title: Event Overlap
description: Stops a calendar event being created or moved onto a clash by listing what it runs into (overlaps, back-to-back with no break, too little travel time between places, busy all-day events, other-zone events read in their own time) on a small timeline, and moving it to the nearest slot that keeps your buffer and travel time in one tap, with Undo.
stops: Meeting booked on top of another
